basis_used: Unchanged local illustrative USD/GiB assumptions dated 2026-10-18. No full provider quotation is asserted.

sources.service_class: Cloud compute and attached block volumes
sources.observation: Compute prices not exposed in fetched dynamic page. Volume documentation specifies 10 GB minimum, 1 GB increments, up to 16 attachments and 10 TB total. Server snapshots/backups exclude attached volumes.
sources.model_limit: Illustrative disk pool is not a purchaseable Hetzner plan. Beyond provider volume limits another storage arrangement and quote are required; its price is unverified. Local full-copy snapshots are explicitly capacity-funded, not assumed included by the provider.

sources.service_class: Cloud instance, SSD block storage and snapshots
sources.region: Not selected; historical assumptions are not a regional quote
sources.observation: Official page lists block storage starting at 8 GB, $0.10 per allocated GB-month, snapshots $0.05 per GB-month, regional transfer allowances and outbound overage rules. This does not substantiate the whole historical $40/4-vCPU/8-GiB/160-GiB bundle or its USD/GiB rates.
sources.model_limit: No regional bundle, maximum volume count/capacity, free-transfer offset or provider-native snapshot tariff silently substituted. Model provisions local full-copy snapshot capacity at its historical disk rate. One attempted AWS block-storage FAQ URL was inaccessible.

sources.provider: Backblaze B2 plus unspecified storage-focused compute host
sources.observation: Official B2 page starts at $6.95 per TB-month and describes free egress up to three times retained storage. It is not a full-node host quotation and is not the historical illustrative $0.006/GiB-month assumption.
sources.model_limit: Use local rates only as explicit historical assumptions. Host disk expansion limits, IOPS and region-specific end-to-end pricing remain unquoted.

unpriced_or_unqualified: provider minimums beyond illustrative 1-GiB billing granularity
tier upgrades above attachment capacity limits
unmeasured retained forks and real finality/reviewer-authority traffic
fully_loaded_meaning: Every listed media-only capacity and expected transfer line is charged in the model. This is not a fully quoted operating bill or a production throughput certification.
